nodes.name: Notifications Feed Page
nodes.responsibility: Renders a scrollable feed of interaction notifications (comments, replies, likes, follows) with per-type card templates

nodes.name: Notification Card Component
nodes.responsibility: Renders a single notification event with type-specific layout: actor avatar, action text, target preview, timestamp, and deeplink

nodes.name: Notifications Service
nodes.responsibility: Data access layer: fetch paginated notifications, mark as read, expose unread count for badge

nodes.name: Notifications Cloud Function Actions
nodes.responsibility: Server-side: list notifications for current user, mark read, create notification records (called by comment/post/follow flows)

nodes.name: Notifications DB Collection
nodes.responsibility: Persistent storage for notification records: type, actor, target, read status, created_at

nodes.name: Messages Page (Conversation List)
nodes.responsibility: Renders the messages tab: Stub notification row pinned at index 0, followed by DM conversation list sorted by most recent message

nodes.name: Messages Cloud Function (Extended)
nodes.responsibility: Existing DM send/listConversations/getConversation/markRead plus new listNotifications action

nodes.name: Comments Cloud Function (Extended)
nodes.responsibility: Existing comment create/delete; extended to emit a notification to the post author when a new top-level comment is created

nodes.name: Stub Notification Row
nodes.responsibility: Synthetic list entry pinned at the top of the messages page showing aggregated unread notification count and latest notification preview; taps navigate to notifications-page

nodes.name: INotification Type Definition
nodes.responsibility: TypeScript interface: id, type enum, actor snapshot, target reference, read status, created_at timestamp

edges.description: Messages page renders the Stub row at position 0 of its list
Fetches unread count for Stub badge
Tap navigates to notifications feed page
Each notification rendered as a card
Sends listNotifications action to cloud function
Queries notification records for the current user
Creates a 'comment' type notification when a new top-level comment is posted
Uses INotification type for data binding
Uses INotification for unread count display
markRead action to mark notifications as read when viewed

boundary_conditions.description: Notification creation idempotency: the same event (e.g. user posts two identical comments) must not create duplicate notification records
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Duplicate notifications clutter the feed and inflate unread counts

boundary_conditions.description: Notification feed pagination: a user may accumulate thousands of notifications over time; the feed must support cursor-based pagination
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Unbounded query returns excessive data, page load degrades linearly

boundary_conditions.description: Stub unread count consistency: the badge count on the Stub row must reflect the actual number of unread notifications in the database
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Stale badge count misleads the user (shows 3 when actually 0, or 0 when actually 5)

boundary_conditions.description: Dangling target references: a notification may reference a post or comment that has since been deleted; the feed must handle this gracefully
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Null-pointer crash or blank card when user taps a notification for deleted content

boundary_conditions.description: Anonymous mode identity in notifications: when an anonymous user comments, the notification shown to the post author must respect the anonymous setting (show '匿名用户' not the real nickname)
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Privacy leak: anonymous commenter's real identity exposed via notification

boundary_conditions.description: CloudBase collection count limits: WeChat CloudBase free tier has read/write quotas; notification creation on every comment must not exceed quotas under normal load
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Quota exhaustion blocks all message/notification operations

notes: The Stub is a UI-level construct, not a real conversation. It is never stored in the conversations collection.
Notification creation is fire-and-forget from the comment/post flow: if notification creation fails, the comment still succeeds.
The notifications collection reuses the existing messages cloud function by adding a new action ('listNotifications') rather than creating a separate cloud function. This avoids Lambda sprawl.
Likes and follows are out of scope for the initial implementation but the notification type enum is designed to accommodate them.
